decided: A sign-off for a program is accepted only when the project signs off once per program, and a sign-off for a change only when it signs off on each change; each refusal says which setting was read and which sign-off it asks for.
alternatives: accept either sign-off under either setting
why: A sign-off the setting does not ask for would be recorded with nothing waiting on it, and a user reading it later could take it for a signature that held something.

relies_on.title: The write gate checks the sign-off record
